notes.title: v.0.3.53 - Small Patch
notes.content: [h3]Standard Version[/h3][p]-A small update to fix some issues with the employee hiring menu and information loading.[/p][p]-Added some new floor types that were already available in experimental mode.[/p][p]-More variety in the traffic.[/p][p]-Other minor bug fixes and improvements.[/p][p][/p][h3]Experimental Mode[/h3][p]-Number of portions in serving table now saves.[/p][p]-Host booth is can be rotated.[/p][p]-Tourist will wait in a region for a table instead of stacking in front of the booth.[/p][p]-Server will stay at their booth on loading. [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: V0.3.51 - Patch and Experimental Update
notes.content: [p]Main - 0.3.51 - Just a quick bug fix for some issues with the employee hiring menu. An issue with the technology tree was preventing proper loading. All employees are available for now until a more permanent fix is available. Also a new color is available for the street performer. Other new features since the last notice include a new Player suit (click on your player image in the top left to change), and traffic which will become more important in the next few months. [/p][p][/p][p]Experimental - NEW! - An experimental version is now available. Opt in through the beta branch. 4 new Buffet objects are available (but poorly implemented - expect frequent crashes). Visitors have a food preference and not everyone will be satisfied by the vending machine alone. Buffets can be profitable but some visitors may take more then their fair share. More details to come soon![/p]

notes.title: Update 10 - The Holiday Update
notes.content:
Wow, another year has passed. I'm still working on some general bug fixes and other background stuff but thought I would take a break to release a few holiday themed items. There are 5 new objects for the holiday season. Fill your outside with snow, complete with a Snowman. If you want to spruce up the inside of your casino, check out the new Christmas Tree and Wreath objects. Finally, a new street performer option is available. Santa Claus himself. Thanks for checking out the game this holiday season. Merry Christmas and Happy New Years!!


[h2]Snow and Snowmen[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42248820/0a9cbc48f8ea470785cc1fd916075046148e0e7b.png[/img]

Add some variety to the dessert. Snow and Snowmen are available in the Outdoor Category. Snowmen can be placed on other other type bases. 

[h2]Christmas Trees[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42248820/b66e875128867b3f09a81523f35499b95db00d1e.png[/img]

A great bit of decor for your casino. Bring in the holiday cheer with a christmas tree. Can be placed anywhere insde the casino. Find it under the Decor Category.

[h2]Wreath[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42248820/25e3e0c7053233f7f0e1b3a6d3c99277c6845acd.png[/img]

Tight on space? Place a wreath. Its like a christmas tree for the wall. Find it next to the christmas tree in the decor build category.

[h2]Santa[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42248820/4ae5ad63ca0b4d777f68b29682fc6b1428ca2e96.png[/img]

Its Santa!.. or is it? Hire a santa to walk the street in front of the casino and draw in more guests. Santas can be hired in the street performer hiring category.

20% Off Sale - November 4-11

It's been awhile but its time for an update! After taking the summer off, I've been hard at work getting this update prepared. It's taken a little while to get it just right but here it is. This is the Pitboss update. Make things a little easier on yourself with a pit boss. After hiring, you can select machines for them to watch. If the machines are over 80% full they'll call a cashier to come empty it. Right now, they are freely available in a new game but eventually they will be locked in the tech. tree. I've got some more jobs planned for them as well... coming soon!

Over the next weeks I'd like to focus on a few bug fixes and tweaks, then I'll be on to the next new system. I'm planning on making the buffet the focus of Update 10. More news to come! 

Thanks for playing!

-Kexster

notes.title: Update 8
notes.content:
This update is focused on work completed by the maintenance staff. Washroom fixtures now need to be cleaned. They'll slowly get worse over time and with use. Get your staff in there to keep the place looking great. Vending machines now will also need to be filled. Make sure to keep them stocked up and your visitors happy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42248820/7c1195bc5136ec7b9bbb87720fbdc5cde50849cb.jpg[/img]

Cleaning products and vending machine good are stored in the new shelves object. Right click to select what gets stored there and then order goods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42248820/e392c4f876a8150d1555f6db9d4a9c822d9e0f4a.jpg[/img]



[u]Changes[/u]

[u]Washrooms[/u]
[list]
[*]Cleaning is now required. Once cleanliness reaches 0, it is out of order.
[*]Cleaning is completed by maintenance staff, using products from shelves.
[/list]

[u]Vending Machines[/u]
[list]
[*]New fill method. Maintenance staff are required to fill vending machines.
[*]Vending machine products are stored on shelves.
[/list]

[u]Shelves[/u]
[list]
[*]New object used to store vending machine and cleaning supplies. Right click to order more goods. 
[*]Keep shelves stocked up. Maintenance staff will grab as much as they can carry and return for more when needed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 6 - Area Menu Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Just a small update this week to improve the area placing menu. It now has a little more information on what exactly the area does along with a few other tweaks.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42248820/dffacc3fd86fec5ea688403c7968576d71649874.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 5 - Employee Update I
notes.content:
This week I updated the employee hiring system. You now have time limited options for hiring and it works with the research system too. This is just the first step in a more complex employee system. Have fun! Thanks for playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42248820/869c34cb00f54c45e3f66258df6b698925ef15bf.png[/img]


[u]Patch Notes:[/u]

-Updates to sidebar graphics
-Added new employee hiring pop-up.
-Employees now have an individual hiring cost. Currently all characters are the same but more complex features are coming.
-Employees have a longer descriptionon what they can do. 
-Fixed and moved some items around the research tree.

notes.title: Cash System Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42248820/e1f5eb85fc6f01f0fd86b6b028f8650b1c2129f3.png[/img]

The Cash System Update

A whole new system has been implemented in Half Built: Casino. Money will no longer automatically flow from games to the bank. All games will now have a small money storage built in and will need to be emptied. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42248820/a8951411299985a372f56520e533781656f7d69d.png[/img]

To collect all that money this update includes a new behavior for cashiers. Right click on a machine to have them collect your 'hard' earned cash. You can also throw on a cashbelt and collect the cash yourself.
Built the new Small Safe item to store your money. Cashiers will drop off the bags of cash or use it yourself. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42248820/75dda3d7b2118ed412256ffbd58d6578f8635ef4.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 3 - Random Mix
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Just another small update for this week. In addition to the new slot types added earlier this week, just a few graphic tweaks and various fixes.

NOTES:
-Updated and changed how the players tools work. 
-Added Cards and a Money Belt to the players tools. This is a preview only and will be useful in the next update!
-Fixed Tools floating around when sitting at the desk.
-Fixed some issues with the green or red box around items that you are building.
-Added some hotkey letters on the right side for the overlays.
-Made some updates to the research screen. Now you can't research 'coming soon' items. Also updated the cost of level two research items.

There may be some issues with old saves with this update! Sorry :)

I'm planning for the next update to be a little bigger. It may be a few weeks. Check back soon.

notes.title: Update - Week 2
notes.content:
[u][b]Week 2 Update[/b][/u]

Thanks again to everyone whos checked out the game. Your support is appreciated! I've continued to work on the ~basics and bugs~ this week as part of the first month of updates.

This week I added a leaderboard to the game. Right now it only will save your top 10 local Casinos. I've got a little more work to do but a global leaderboard is on the way! 

[u]Update Notes[/u]

-Added the leaderboard to the start menu!
-Fixed an issue where Sic-bo was acting like roulette. Cashier count is corrected and the animation removed for now.
-Added a second dice and wiggle to the selection on the start menu screen. 
-Fixed an issue with the office desk and player causing a crash.
-Added some new objects and tools for the next update, including a money bag, garbage bag, and safe. Not available yet but hopefully will be released next week.

notes.title: Week 1 Update - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who played the game. I've been busy this week working on fixing issues related to the cashier and cashier booths. They are working much better now including the queue.

Patch Notes:
- Games and Objects can't be built on top of doors anymore
- Updated tutorial on the side to reflect any changes 
- Fixed an issue with garbage can placement
- Fixed an issue with placing queue pieces
- Fixed issue with visitors not entering casino if decor is placed on it.
- Updated the quite sprite to show in front of visitors.
- Office Desk can be right clicked and sold.
- Cashiers move to no locations if cashier booth is sold.
- Slot Machine 01 doesn't duplicate its chair when moved.
- Various other minor tweaks.

I'm going to get back to work on the game. I have some ideas to make the early game a little more interactive. I hope to share more details soon.

Look me up on Patreon for other buying options under "Short Olive Games". :)
